name: Operation Aurora
description: 2010 cyberattack campaign targeting Google, Adobe, Juniper Networks, and over 30 other companies, attributed to Chinese APT actors seeking source code and Gmail access.

name: Operation Shady RAT
description: Multi-year intrusion campaign discovered in 2011 targeting 72 organizations including governments, defense contractors, and international bodies. Attributed to Chinese actors.

name: Operation Night Dragon
description: Coordinated cyber attacks against global oil, energy, and petrochemical companies targeting operational data, SCADA systems, and financial data.

name: Operation Cleaver
description: Iranian-linked operation targeting critical infrastructure, transportation, airlines, and defense contractors across 16 countries.

name: Operation Pawn Storm
description: Long-running espionage campaign by APT28 targeting NATO governments, military, and political parties using spear-phishing and zero-day exploits.

name: SolarWinds Attack
description: Sophisticated supply chain attack compromising SolarWinds Orion software updates, affecting 18,000+ organizations including US government agencies and major tech companies.

name: Operation Exchange Marauder
description: HAFNIUM group exploitation of four zero-day vulnerabilities in Microsoft Exchange Server, affecting 250,000+ servers globally.

name: Kaseya VSA Supply Chain Attack
description: REvil ransomware attack exploiting zero-day in Kaseya VSA remote management software, encrypting thousands of downstream MSP customers.

name: Log4Shell Exploitation
description: Mass exploitation campaign targeting the Log4j vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228), affecting millions of Java applications worldwide. Multiple APT groups and ransomware actors exploited.

name: Colonial Pipeline Attack
description: DarkSide ransomware attack on Colonial Pipeline causing shutdown of the largest US fuel pipeline and widespread fuel shortages across the US East Coast.

name: JBS Foods Attack
description: REvil ransomware attack on JBS Foods, the world's largest meat processing company, disrupting operations across US, Canada, and Australia.

name: Operation Triangulation
description: Sophisticated iOS zero-click attack campaign using zero-day vulnerabilities to implant malware on iPhones, discovered by Kaspersky Lab targeting their own employees.

name: MOVEit Transfer Campaign
description: Cl0p ransomware group exploited zero-day vulnerability in MOVEit Transfer software, affecting 2,000+ organizations and 60+ million individuals including US government agencies.

name: GoAnywhere Attack
description: Cl0p exploitation of zero-day in Fortra's GoAnywhere MFT platform, affecting 130+ organizations including Procter & Gamble and Virgin Red.

name: 3CX Supply Chain Attack
description: North Korean-linked supply chain attack on 3CX VoIP software, marking the first recorded software supply chain attack leading to another supply chain attack (Trading Technologies).

name: XZ Utils Backdoor
description: Sophisticated multi-year social engineering campaign inserting a backdoor into XZ Utils (liblzma), affecting multiple Linux distributions. Nearly succeeded in compromising SSH authentication.

name: Change Healthcare Attack
description: ALPHV/BlackCat ransomware attack on Change Healthcare causing the largest healthcare data breach in US history, affecting 100+ million Americans and disrupting prescription processing nationwide.

name: NotPetya Campaign
description: Destructive malware masquerading as ransomware, initially targeting Ukraine via compromised accounting software M.E.Doc and spreading globally. Caused $10B+ in damages.

name: WannaCry Campaign
description: Global ransomware attack exploiting EternalBlue NSA exploit, affecting 200,000+ systems across 150 countries including the UK NHS. Linked to North Korean Lazarus Group.

name: Operation Soft Cell
description: Multi-year espionage campaign targeting telecommunications providers globally to enable interception of mobile communications.

name: Volt Typhoon Infrastructure Campaign
description: Pre-positioning operation by Chinese APT to establish persistent access to US critical infrastructure including water, power, and transportation sectors for potential future disruption.

name: Salt Typhoon Telecom Campaign
description: Chinese espionage campaign breaching major US telecommunications providers including AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile to access lawful intercept systems and senior officials' communications.

name: Operation GhostShell
description: Iranian espionage campaign targeting aerospace and telecom sectors across Middle East, targeting sensitive business data and employee credentials.

name: Midnight Blizzard Microsoft Attack
description: APT29 breach of Microsoft corporate email accounts including senior leadership, using password spray attacks and OAuth app abuse to steal emails and source code.

name: Operation Duck Hunt
description: FBI-led international law enforcement operation that dismantled the QakBot botnet, seizing 52+ servers and deleting malware from 700,000+ infected machines.

name: Scattered Spider MGM Attack
description: Social engineering attack on MGM Resorts International using vishing to compromise Okta SSO, deploying BlackCat ransomware and causing $100M+ in losses.

name: Ivanti Zero-Day Campaign
description: Mass exploitation of Ivanti Connect Secure VPN zero-day vulnerabilities (CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2024-21887) by multiple threat actors including Chinese APTs.

name: Operation Medusa
description: FBI-led operation dismantling Turla's Snake malware network after two decades of operation, infecting computers in 50+ countries.

name: CDK Global Attack
description: Ransomware attack on CDK Global disrupting operations at thousands of US car dealerships for weeks, causing hundreds of millions in damages.

name: Snowflake Customer Campaign
description: Credential-based attack campaign targeting Snowflake cloud storage customers using stolen credentials, compromising AT&T, Ticketmaster, LendingTree and 160+ other organizations.
